what_helped.educational_guardrail: Separate options-risk review from long-equity review before evaluating behavior.
what_helped.evidence_strength_reason: compares asset-type aggregates without recalculating option multipliers
what_helped.finding: Option and equity outcomes differed in the high-confidence completed-trade sample.
what_helped.limitation: Options with basis transfers or unresolved lifecycle events are excluded.

what_hurt.educational_guardrail: Review realized outcomes separately from deposits, withdrawals, and unresolved records.
what_hurt.finding: High-confidence completed trades had net realized P&L of -603.
what_hurt.limitation: Analytical realized P&L is not tax P&L and excludes unresolved trades.

what_hurt.educational_guardrail: Set a monthly trading-frequency review threshold and compare outcomes after the month closes.
what_hurt.evidence_strength_reason: high activity is defined by the documented 75th percentile monthly trade-count rule
what_hurt.finding: High-activity months were compared with other eligible months without claiming causation.
what_hurt.limitation: Month-level aggregation cannot prove trading frequency caused outcomes.

what_hurt.educational_guardrail: Review whether one loss can erase several typical gains before entering a trade.
what_hurt.evidence_strength_reason: largest-loss concentration is computed from opaque grouped high-confidence trades
what_hurt.finding: A small number of losses accounted for a measurable share of gross losses.
what_hurt.limitation: Excluded unknown-basis and unmatched records may hide additional losses.
